avoid_for: Consumer retail, playful multi-color brands, image-led lifestyle marketing, or any context needing loud or emotional display — the whisper-weight headlines, single-cyan restraint, and flat paper surfaces make this a calm analytical voice that struggles with high-energy consumer pitches.
best_for: Analytics and B2B SaaS landing pages (analytics, dashboards, developer tools) that want an editorial, quietly confident register — warm stone canvas, one cyan CTA, weight-400 geometric headlines, flat white cards with hairline borders, and a grayscale dashboard mockup as the hero proof.
name: Seline Analytics
palette_voice: A warm-stone canvas (#fafaf9) reads as paper, not screen, with flat white (#ffffff) cards floating above it; 1px stone hairlines (#e8e6e5) are the primary structural device instead of heavy dividers or panels; the single vivid cyan (#3ba6f1) is the only chromatic voice — one filled CTA plus one cyan highlight span per headline, the loudest thing on the page by deliberate restraint of everything else; a near-black Ink (#0c0a09) carries all headings.
signature_moves: The weight-400 headline whisper: Roobert at 52px/400 with tight negative tracking (-0.021em) — authority through restraint, never bumping to 600/700
Exactly one cyan highlight span per headline (#3398e1 text on a #c1e1f7 pill wash) marking the value-prop keyword — the brand's voice marker
The cyan filled pill CTA (#3ba6f1, 9999px radius) as the only chromatic filled element on any screen, used once per viewport maximum
Flat white content cards defined by 1px stone borders, not shadows — the border IS the structure; only the hero dashboard preview earns a deep floating shadow
The hooded line-art mascot sticker with drop-shadow, used once per section as a playful counterweight to the monochrome data UI

source.leading_note: fallback, no --leading-body token in variables.css; DESIGN.md names 14px Inter weight 400 at 1.64 line-height as the dominant body size (--leading-body-lg is 1.69)
source.radius: 9999px buttons/tags, 10px cards, 16px feature cards, 6px inputs, 4px icons
source.shadow: content cards rgba(0,0,0,0.05) 0px 4px 16px 0px; single hero floating preview rgba(17,12,46,0.12) 0px 12px 45px 0px

tagline: Quiet analyst's desk on warm paper
typographic_voice: A two-face system: Roobert (subst. Inter Tight/Satoshi) is the display voice at weight 400 only (18–52px) with tight negative tracking (-0.025em at 32px, -0.021em at 52px) — headlines occupy their space without shouting; Inter is the neutral workhorse for all body/nav/UI at 14px weight 400 with 1.64 line-height and positive tracking at small sizes; no bold headings, no serif, no italic, no gradients.
